## API Contract
POST /demo/attack -> AttackResponse; controlled malicious $4,000 candidate plus independent rejection evidence

Canonical examples: `contracts/financial-state.example.json`, `contracts/action-request.example.json`, `contracts/requests.example.json`. These are shape fixtures, never evidence of live chain configuration or successful verification. Error envelope: `{"code":"NOT_IMPLEMENTED","message":"Feature awaiting implementation","reasons":[]}`. Amounts ending `_minor` are integer USD cents; token base units are decimal strings; probabilities are integer basis points.

## Definition of Done
